p='inputs/JuliaJong_CRISPRa_BCL2_B3GNT_cacerResTcellCytotoxicity_supplData1_mageck.xlsx'
ns={'m':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main','r':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships','pr':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'}
with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
    wb=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    rel=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    relmap={x.attrib['Id']:x.attrib['Target'] for x in rel}
    sst=[]
    ss=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in ss.findall('m:si',ns):
        sst.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{%s}t'%ns['m'])))
    print('sheets:')
    for sh in wb.find('m:sheets',ns):
        target=relmap[sh.attrib['{%s}id'%ns['r']]]
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target='xl/'+target
        print(sh.attrib['name'], target)
        root=ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        dim=root.find('m:dimension',ns)
        print(' dimension', dim.attrib.get('ref') if dim is not None else None)
        for row in root.findall('.//m:sheetData/m:row',ns)[:8]:
            vals=[]
            for c in row.findall('m:c',ns)[:20]:
                ref=c.attrib.get('r'); typ=c.attrib.get('t'); v=c.find('m:v',ns)
                val=None if v is None else v.text
                if typ=='s' and val is not None: val=sst[int(val)]
                elif typ=='inlineStr':
                    val=''.join(t.text or '' for t in c.iter('{%s}t'%ns['m']))
                vals.append(f'{ref}={val"'!r}'"')
            print('  row',row.attrib.get('r'), ' | '.join(vals))
PY"
